<style id="rr-css">:root{--navy:#0B1530;--navy2:#111F47;--blue:#2F5BFF;--sky:#38BDF8;--gold:#F2B544;--ink:#0F172A;--slate:#475569;--line:#E3E8F2;--bg:#F6F8FC}
body{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}
.rr-wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.rr-sec{padding:96px 24px}.rr-sec-sm{padding:56px 24px}
.rr-soft{background:var(--bg)}.rr-dark{background:radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 80% -10%,#1d3a9e 0%,rgba(29,58,158,0) 60%),linear-gradient(180deg,#0B1530 0%,#0A1229 100%);color:#fff}
.rr-eyebrow .elementor-heading-title{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:600 13px/1 Inter,sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)!important;background:rgba(47,91,255,.08);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px}
.rr-dark .rr-eyebrow .elementor-heading-title{color:#9CC2FF!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.rr-h1 .elementor-heading-title{font:800 clamp(38px,5.4vw,64px)/1.05 Poppins,sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.rr-h2 .elementor-heading-title{font:700 clamp(30px,3.6vw,44px)/1.15 Poppins,sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:var(--ink)}
.rr-dark .rr-h2 .elementor-heading-title,.rr-dark .rr-h1 .elementor-heading-title{color:#fff}
.rr-h1 .elementor-heading-title span,.rr-h2 .elementor-heading-title span{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#5B8CFF,#38BDF8);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.rr-lead{font-size:18px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--slate)}.rr-dark .rr-lead{color:#C7D2EA}
.rr-lead p{margin:0 0 12px}
.rr-btn .elementor-button{font:600 16px/1 Inter,sans-serif;padding:17px 26px;border-radius:12px;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.rr-btn .elementor-button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.rr-btn-primary .elementor-button{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2F5BFF,#3B82F6);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(47,91,255,.7)}
.rr-btn-gold .elementor-button{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F7C66A,#F2A93B);color:#1b1407;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(242,169,59,.7)}
.rr-btn-ghost .elementor-button{background:transparent;color:#fff;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.rr-btn-outline .elementor-button{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:1.5px solid var(--line)}
.rr-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04);transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s,border-color .25s}
.rr-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 24px 48px -24px rgba(15,23,42,.25);border-color:#C9D6FF}
.rr-iconbox .elementor-icon{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(47,91,255,.12),rgba(56,189,248,.12));color:var(--blue);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;font-size:26px}
.rr-iconbox .elementor-icon-box-title{font:700 20px/1.3 Poppins,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:8px}
.rr-iconbox .elementor-icon-box-description{color:var(--slate);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.65}
.rr-counter .elementor-counter-number-wrapper{font:800 46px/1 Poppins,sans-serif;color:#fff}
.rr-counter .elementor-counter-title{color:#9CC2FF;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-top:8px}
.rr-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.rr-nav a{color:var(--ink);font:500 15px/1 Inter,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px}
.rr-nav a:hover{background:var(--bg);color:var(--blue)}
.rr-nav a.rr-cta{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:12px 18px;margin-left:6px}.rr-nav a.rr-cta:hover{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.rr-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);backdrop-filter:saturate(1.6) blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(227,232,242,.8)}
.rr-burger{display:none}
@media(max-width:1024px){.rr-nav{display:none;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;background:#fff;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.rr-nav.open{display:flex}.rr-burger{display:inline-flex;background:var(--bg);border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer}}
.rr-trust{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:8px}
.rr-trust span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#E6ECFA;font:600 13.5px/1 Inter,sans-serif;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:999px}
.rr-trust b{color:var(--gold)}
.rr-hero-photo{position:relative;max-width:520px;margin-left:auto}
.rr-hero-photo:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:8% 6% 0 6%;border-radius:32px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2F5BFF 0%,#1a2f7a 55%,#0B1530 100%);box-shadow:0 40px 80px -30px rgba(47,91,255,.6)}
.rr-hero-photo img{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:0 0 32px 32px}
.rr-float{position:absolute;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px -18px rgba(2,6,23,.45);font:600 13px/1.3 Inter,sans-serif;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.rr-float strong{display:block;font:800 20px/1 Poppins,sans-serif}
.rr-float i{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;font-size:18px;background:#EEF3FF}
.rr-f1{left:-6%;top:28%}.rr-f2{right:-4%;top:12%}.rr-f3{left:4%;bottom:8%}
@media(max-width:767px){.rr-f1,.rr-f2,.rr-f3{display:none}}
.rr-logos{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px 34px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#64748B;font:700 18px/1 Poppins,sans-serif}
.rr-logos a{color:#64748B;text-decoration:none;opacity:.85}.rr-logos a:hover{color:var(--blue);opacity:1}
.rr-gigs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.rr-gigs{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}@media(max-width:640px){.rr-gigs{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rr-gig{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;text-decoration:none!important;color:var(--ink)!important;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.rr-gig:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 30px 50px -28px rgba(15,23,42,.35)}
.rr-gig-img{aspect-ratio:16/10;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg)}.rr-gig-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .5s}.rr-gig:hover .rr-gig-img img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.rr-gig-body{padding:16px 18px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;flex:1}
.rr-gig-seller{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:600 13px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--slate)}
.rr-gig-seller img{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.rr-badge{margin-left:auto;font:700 11px/1 Inter,sans-serif;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:#FFF5DE;color:#9A6400}
.rr-badge.up{background:#E8F7EE;color:#0F7B3E}.rr-badge.fv{background:#E6FAF1;color:#108A5C}.rr-badge.nx{background:#EEF3FF;color:#2F5BFF}
.rr-gig-title{font:600 16px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);min-height:44px}
.rr-gig-rate{font:700 14px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}.rr-gig-rate b{color:#F59E0B}.rr-gig-rate span{color:#94A3B8;font-weight:500}
.rr-gig-foot{margin-top:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font:600 12px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:#94A3B8;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
.rr-gig-foot strong{font:800 18px/1 Poppins,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0}
.rr-cases{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px}@media(max-width:1000px){.rr-cases{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}@media(max-width:640px){.rr-cases{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rr-case{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.rr-case:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 30px 50px -28px rgba(15,23,42,.35)}
.rr-case img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10;object-fit:cover;object-position:top}
.rr-case div{padding:18px 20px 22px}.rr-case h3{font:700 18px/1.35 Poppins,sans-serif;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--ink)}
.rr-case p{margin:0;color:var(--slate);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6}
.rr-tag{display:inline-block;font:700 11px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);background:#EEF3FF;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:10px}
.rr-ways{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px}@media(max-width:900px){.rr-ways{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rr-way{border-radius:20px;padding:30px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.rr-way.hl{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#0B1530,#16295E);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(11,21,48,.8)}
.rr-way h3{font:700 22px/1.25 Poppins,sans-serif;margin:12px 0 8px}.rr-way p{color:var(--slate);margin:0 0 18px;line-height:1.6}.rr-way.hl p{color:#C7D2EA}
.rr-way ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 22px;display:grid;gap:9px}.rr-way li:before{content:"✓";color:var(--blue);font-weight:800;margin-right:8px}.rr-way.hl li:before{color:var(--gold)}
.rr-way a.go{display:inline-block;font:600 15px/1 Inter,sans-serif;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:11px;text-decoration:none;background:var(--navy);color:#fff}.rr-way.hl a.go{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F7C66A,#F2A93B);color:#1b1407}
.rr-pill{display:inline-block;font:700 11px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#EEF3FF;color:var(--blue)}.rr-way.hl .rr-pill{background:rgba(242,181,68,.16);color:var(--gold)}
.rr-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;counter-reset:s}@media(max-width:900px){.rr-steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}@media(max-width:560px){.rr-steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rr-step{padding:26px;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.rr-step:before{counter-increment:s;content:"0" counter(s);font:800 34px/1 Poppins,sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2F5BFF,#38BDF8);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.rr-step h3{font:700 18px/1.3 Poppins,sans-serif;margin:14px 0 6px}.rr-step p{margin:0;color:var(--slate);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.rr-quotes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px}@media(max-width:900px){.rr-quotes{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rr-quote{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:28px}
.rr-quote .s{color:#F59E0B;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:16px}.rr-quote blockquote{margin:12px 0 18px;font:500 17px/1.6 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}
.rr-quote cite{font-style:normal;color:var(--slate);font-size:14px}.rr-quote cite b{display:block;color:var(--ink)}
.rr-faq details{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 22px;margin-bottom:12px}
.rr-faq summary{cursor:pointer;font:600 17px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.rr-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.rr-faq summary:after{content:"+";font-size:22px;color:var(--blue)}.rr-faq details[open] summary:after{content:"–"}
.rr-faq details p{margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.7}
.rr-cta-band{border-radius:28px;padding:56px;background:radial-gradient(800px 300px at 90% 0%,#2F5BFF 0%,rgba(47,91,255,0) 60%),linear-gradient(135deg,#0B1530,#14245C);color:#fff;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.rr-cta-band h2{font:800 clamp(26px,3vw,38px)/1.2 Poppins,sans-serif;margin:0 0 8px;color:#fff}.rr-cta-band p{margin:0;color:#C7D2EA;font-size:17px}
.rr-cta-band .b{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.rr-cta-band a{font:600 16px/1 Inter,sans-serif;padding:16px 22px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none}
.rr-cta-band a.g{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F7C66A,#F2A93B);color:#1b1407}.rr-cta-band a.w{border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);color:#fff}
.rr-footer{background:#0A1229;color:#AAB6D3;padding:72px 24px 28px}
.rr-footer a{color:#D7E0F5;text-decoration:none}.rr-footer a:hover{color:#fff}
.rr-fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:36px}@media(max-width:900px){.rr-fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.rr-fgrid h4{color:#fff;font:700 15px/1 Poppins,sans-serif;margin:0 0 16px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.rr-fgrid ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;gap:10px;font-size:14.5px}
.rr-social{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:16px}.rr-social a{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);font:700 12px/1 Inter,sans-serif}
.rr-social a:hover{background:var(--blue)}
.rr-copy{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);margin-top:44px;padding-top:22px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:13.5px}
.rr-pk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}@media(max-width:900px){.rr-pk{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rr-pkg{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.rr-pkg.pop{border:2px solid var(--blue);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(47,91,255,.55);position:relative}
.rr-popular{position:absolute;top:-13px;left:24px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font:700 11px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px}
.rr-pkg h3{margin:0;font:700 14px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate)}
.rr-pkg .p{font:800 40px/1 Poppins,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}.rr-pkg .p small{font:600 14px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--slate);margin-left:6px}
.rr-pkg .d{color:var(--slate);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;min-height:48px}
.rr-pkg .m{display:flex;gap:14px;font:600 13.5px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}
.rr-pkg ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:4px 0 6px;display:grid;gap:9px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink)}.rr-pkg li:before{content:"✓";color:#16A34A;font-weight:800;margin-right:8px}
.rr-pkg .nfp-pay-button-form{display:block!important}.rr-pkg .nfp-pay-button{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2F5BFF,#3B82F6)!important;border-radius:12px!important;padding:15px!important}
.rr-alt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font-size:14px}.rr-alt a{display:block;text-align:center;padding:12px;border-radius:11px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}.rr-alt a:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
.rr-note{font-size:13px;color:#94A3B8;text-align:center}
.rr-prose{max-width:820px}.rr-prose h3{font:700 22px/1.3 Poppins,sans-serif;margin:28px 0 10px;color:var(--ink)}.rr-prose p,.rr-prose li{color:var(--slate);line-height:1.75;font-size:16.5px}
.rr-tl{border-left:2px solid var(--line);padding-left:26px;display:grid;gap:26px}
.rr-tl div{position:relative}.rr-tl div:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-33px;top:4px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #EEF3FF}
.rr-tl b{display:block;font:700 17px/1.3 Poppins,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}.rr-tl span{font:700 12px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--blue);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}.rr-tl p{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.6}
.rr-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}.rr-chips span{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 14px;font:600 14px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}
.rr-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:28px}.rr-tabs a{padding:12px 18px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);font:600 15px/1 Inter,sans-serif;background:#fff}.rr-tabs a:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
.rr-grid3>.elementor-element{width:calc(33.333% - 15px)!important}
@media(max-width:1024px){.rr-grid3>.elementor-element{width:calc(50% - 11px)!important}}@media(max-width:640px){.rr-grid3>.elementor-element{width:100%!important}}
.rr-counter{min-width:200px;text-align:center}
.rr-narrow{max-width:860px!important}
.rr-about-photo img,.rr-gig-cover img{border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(11,21,48,.6)}
.rr-dark .rr-gig-cover img{box-shadow:0 40px 80px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.elementor-widget-html{width:100%}
.e-con.rr-pkg{--padding-top:26px;--padding-right:26px;--padding-bottom:26px;--padding-left:26px}
.rr-header .elementor-widget-image img{display:block}
.rr-tabs+*{margin-top:0}
a.rr-cta[aria-current]{background:var(--blue)}.rr-nav a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--blue)}
.rr-header .elementor-widget-image img{width:230px!important;max-width:none;height:auto}
@media(max-width:767px){.rr-header .elementor-widget-image img{width:180px!important}}
.rr-header .elementor-widget-html{width:auto!important;margin-left:auto}
.rr-hero-photo img{border-radius:32px}
.elementor-widget-counter .elementor-counter-title,.elementor-icon-box-description,.elementor-widget-text-editor,.elementor-icon-list-text,.elementor-button{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif!important}
.elementor-icon-box-title,.elementor-heading-title{font-family:Poppins,Inter,sans-serif}
.rr-gig-img img{object-position:top left}

.rr-h1s .elementor-heading-title{font:800 clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px)/1.12 Poppins,sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:#fff}
.rr-pkg .m{margin:2px 0 4px}.rr-pkg ul{margin-top:6px}
/* v2 */
.rr-narrow{max-width:860px!important;margin-left:auto!important;margin-right:auto!important;width:100%}
.rr-header{position:sticky!important;top:0;z-index:999}
.admin-bar .rr-header{top:32px}@media(max-width:782px){.admin-bar .rr-header{top:46px}}@media(max-width:600px){.admin-bar .rr-header{top:0}}
.elementor-widget-html:has(>.elementor-widget-container>span[id]:only-child){display:none}
.rr-dd{position:relative}.rr-dd-t em{font-style:normal;font-size:11px;margin-left:2px;opacity:.6}
.rr-dd-m{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,6px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:6px;min-width:620px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:14px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(15,23,42,.3);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.18s;z-index:1000}
.rr-dd-m:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-12px;height:12px}
.rr-dd:hover .rr-dd-m,.rr-dd:focus-within .rr-dd-m{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.rr-dd-c p{margin:4px 10px 8px;font:700 11px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#94A3B8}
.rr-dd-c a{display:flex!important;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px!important;border-radius:12px}
.rr-dd-c a i{width:34px;height:34px;flex:none;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#EEF3FF;color:var(--blue);font-size:14px}
.rr-dd-c a b{display:block;font:600 14.5px/1.3 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}.rr-dd-c a small{display:block;font:400 12.5px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--slate);margin-top:2px}
.rr-dd-c a.all{font:600 13.5px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--blue)!important;padding:12px 10px!important}
@media(max-width:1024px){.rr-dd-m{position:static;transform:none;opacity:1;visibility:visible;min-width:0;grid-template-columns:1fr;box-shadow:none;border:0;padding:0 0 0 10px}.rr-dd-t em{display:none}}
.rr-case{display:block;text-decoration:none!important;color:inherit!important}
.rr-more{display:inline-block;margin-top:12px;font:600 14px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--blue)}

Who is Rysul Islam Riak?

Rysul Islam Riak is an SEO and AI search expert and WordPress web designer from Bangladesh who works with businesses in the USA, Canada, Australia and the UK. He is the founder and CEO of OminiGrowth AI and Nexora OMS.

What does an SEO expert do for my business?

I find what stops your website from ranking, fix it on your site (technical SEO, on-page SEO, schema, speed and content), optimize your Google Business Profile and track the results in Google Search Console every week.

Do you work with clients in the USA, Canada and Australia?

Yes. Most of my clients are in the USA, Canada, Australia and the UK. I work in your time zone for calls and send weekly updates.

What is AI search optimization (GEO and AEO)?

Generative engine optimization and answer engine optimization make your business the source that ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews quote, using entity signals, structured data and answer-ready content.

How can I hire you?

Order a package directly on this site, hire me on Upwork or order my gigs on Fiverr. You can also book a free consultation first.

How long does SEO take to show results?

Technical fixes and Google Business Profile changes often show within weeks; competitive rankings usually take three to six months of consistent work.

Gigs start at $25 for content and $30 for one page of on-page SEO; AI search and full SEO packages are $300 to $700. Ongoing monthly SEO is quoted after a free audit.

Technical and Google Business Profile fixes often show within weeks; competitive rankings usually take three to six months.

Do you work with businesses in Canada?

Yes. I work with businesses across Canada. I work in Eastern and Pacific time for calls, and I understand English and French search behaviour across Canadian cities.

How much does an SEO expert in Canada cost?

Gigs start at $25 for content and $30 for one page of on-page SEO; AI search and full SEO packages are $300 to $700. Ongoing monthly SEO is quoted after a free audit.

Can you help my business show in Google Maps?

Yes. Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization are a core part of my work for service businesses.

Do you also optimize for ChatGPT and AI Overviews?

Yes. Every project includes AI search readiness: entity signals, schema and answer-ready content.

Do I need a local Canada SEO agency?

Not necessarily. What matters is local know-how, results and communication. I work remotely with clients in your time zone and track everything in Search Console.

Order directly, on Fiverr or on Upwork — whichever is easiest for you.

Technical and Google Business Profile fixes often show within weeks; competitive rankings usually take three to six months.

Weekly Search Console reports and the next improvements, every week.

Do you work with businesses in Australia?

Yes. I work with businesses across Australia. Bangladesh is only four to five hours behind eastern Australia, so we share most of the working day — fast replies and calls at normal hours.

How much does an SEO expert in Australia cost?

Gigs start at $25 for content and $30 for one page of on-page SEO; AI search and full SEO packages are $300 to $700. Ongoing monthly SEO is quoted after a free audit.

Can you help my business show in Google Maps?

Yes. Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization are a core part of my work for service businesses.

Do you also optimize for ChatGPT and AI Overviews?

Yes. Every project includes AI search readiness: entity signals, schema and answer-ready content.

Do I need a local Australia SEO agency?

Not necessarily. What matters is local know-how, results and communication. I work remotely with clients in your time zone and track everything in Search Console.

How do I pay?

Order directly, on Fiverr or on Upwork — whichever is easiest for you.

How soon will I see results?

Technical and Google Business Profile fixes often show within weeks; competitive rankings usually take three to six months.

Do you build websites too?

Yes. I design SEO-ready WordPress websites with Elementor.

settings.title: Technical SEO services that fix what holds you back

settings.editor: I find and fix what stops Google and AI search from crawling, indexing and ranking your website — directly on your WordPress site, not in a PDF.

settings.description_text: Crawl, indexing, status codes, duplicate pages and Core Web Vitals checked page by page.
Faster LCP, stable layouts and lighter pages for better rankings and conversions.
Broken links, redirect chains and canonical tags cleaned up.
Clean XML sitemaps and crawl rules so Google spends time on pages that matter.
Organization, LocalBusiness, Product, FAQ and Article schema across the site.
Coverage, performance and Core Web Vitals monitored weekly.

settings.html:
Who this is for

  • Sites that lost traffic after an update or redesign
  • WordPress and WooCommerce sites with many pages
  • Businesses whose pages are not getting indexed
  • Teams that want fixes done, not just reported

Problems I fix

  • Pages "Discovered – currently not indexed"
  • Slow pages and poor Core Web Vitals
  • Duplicate content and wrong canonicals
  • Redirect chains and 404 errors
  • Missing or broken structured data

Free audit

I check your website, Google Business Profile and AI visibility, and show you the gaps.

Strategy call

We agree on goals, keywords and the pages that bring revenue.

I fix and build

Technical fixes, on-page SEO, schema, content and local SEO, done on your site.

Track and grow

Weekly Search Console reports and the next improvements, every week.

What is technical SEO?

Technical SEO makes sure search engines can crawl, render and index your website efficiently: site speed, indexing, redirects, canonicals, sitemaps and structured data.

Do you fix the issues or just report them?

I fix them. I am a WordPress developer turned SEO specialist, so changes are implemented on your site and verified in Search Console.

How long does a technical SEO audit take?

A typical audit and first round of fixes takes 3 to 7 days depending on site size.

Will technical SEO help AI search too?

Yes. AI tools rely on pages they can crawl and understand, so clean technical SEO and schema help you appear in AI answers.

settings.editor: Show up when nearby customers search for your service. I optimize your Google Business Profile, build service-area pages and fix the local signals Google uses to rank businesses.

settings.title: Local SEO & Google Maps: what you get

settings.description_text: Categories, services, description, photos and posts optimized for your keywords.
Unique city and neighbourhood pages that rank for "service + city" searches.
Your name, address and phone made consistent across the web.
Structured data that tells Google exactly where and what you serve.
A simple system to get more genuine reviews and reply to them well.
Map and organic positions tracked for your main services and cities.

settings.html:
Who this is for

  • Plumbers, HVAC, electricians, cleaners and repair companies
  • Clinics, dentists, salons and local shops
  • Multi-location and service-area businesses
  • Businesses in the USA, Canada, Australia and the UK

Problems I fix

  • Not showing in the Map Pack
  • Competitors ranking above you nearby
  • Few reviews or no replies
  • One page trying to rank for every city
  • Inconsistent listings and citations

Free audit

I check your website, Google Business Profile and AI visibility, and show you the gaps.

Strategy call

We agree on goals, keywords and the pages that bring revenue.

I fix and build

Technical fixes, on-page SEO, schema, content and local SEO, done on your site.

Track and grow

Weekly Search Console reports and the next improvements, every week.

How long does local SEO take?

Google Business Profile changes can show within weeks; competitive map rankings usually take two to four months.

Do I need a physical address?

No. Service-area businesses can rank without showing an address, as long as the profile is set up correctly.

Do you create city pages?

Yes, with unique content for each city or area, not copied templates.

Can you help with reviews?

Yes. I set up a review request process and reply templates; I never use fake reviews.

settings.editor: Generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) make your business the source that ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews quote and recommend.

settings.description_text: Consistent facts about your business across your site, profiles and the web.
Clear answers to the questions customers ask AI tools, written to be quoted.
Structured data and an llms.txt file that help AI understand your site.
A plan to be mentioned on the sites AI models trust in your niche.
Regular checks of how AI tools describe and recommend you.
AI search builds on classic SEO, so rankings improve too.

settings.html:
Who this is for

  • Brands that want to be recommended by ChatGPT
  • Businesses losing clicks to AI Overviews
  • Consultants, SaaS and service businesses
  • Ecommerce brands with comparison searches

Problems I fix

  • AI tools not mentioning your brand
  • Wrong or outdated facts in AI answers
  • Competitors recommended instead of you
  • Content that AI cannot easily quote
  • Missing schema and entity data

Free audit

I check your website, Google Business Profile and AI visibility, and show you the gaps.

Strategy call

We agree on goals, keywords and the pages that bring revenue.

I fix and build

Technical fixes, on-page SEO, schema, content and local SEO, done on your site.

Track and grow

Weekly Search Console reports and the next improvements, every week.

What is GEO?

Generative engine optimization is the work of making your content and brand the source that AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity use in their answers.

What is AEO?

Answer engine optimization structures your content as clear answers so search features and AI assistants can quote it directly.

Is AI SEO different from normal SEO?

It builds on SEO but adds entity signals, answer-first content, citations and AI visibility checks.

Can you guarantee ChatGPT will mention me?

No one can guarantee it, but the steps I use are the ones that consistently increase how often brands are cited.

<style id="rr-css">:root{--navy:#0B1530;--navy2:#111F47;--blue:#2F5BFF;--sky:#38BDF8;--gold:#F2B544;--ink:#0F172A;--slate:#475569;--line:#E3E8F2;--bg:#F6F8FC}
body{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}
.rr-wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.rr-sec{padding:96px 24px}.rr-sec-sm{padding:56px 24px}
.rr-soft{background:var(--bg)}.rr-dark{background:radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 80% -10%,#1d3a9e 0%,rgba(29,58,158,0) 60%),linear-gradient(180deg,#0B1530 0%,#0A1229 100%);color:#fff}
.rr-eyebrow .elementor-heading-title{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:600 13px/1 Inter,sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)!important;background:rgba(47,91,255,.08);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px}
.rr-dark .rr-eyebrow .elementor-heading-title{color:#9CC2FF!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.rr-h1 .elementor-heading-title{font:800 clamp(38px,5.4vw,64px)/1.05 Poppins,sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.rr-h2 .elementor-heading-title{font:700 clamp(30px,3.6vw,44px)/1.15 Poppins,sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:var(--ink)}
.rr-dark .rr-h2 .elementor-heading-title,.rr-dark .rr-h1 .elementor-heading-title{color:#fff}
.rr-h1 .elementor-heading-title span,.rr-h2 .elementor-heading-title span{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#5B8CFF,#38BDF8);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.rr-lead{font-size:18px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--slate)}.rr-dark .rr-lead{color:#C7D2EA}
.rr-lead p{margin:0 0 12px}
.rr-btn .elementor-button{font:600 16px/1 Inter,sans-serif;padding:17px 26px;border-radius:12px;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.rr-btn .elementor-button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.rr-btn-primary .elementor-button{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2F5BFF,#3B82F6);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(47,91,255,.7)}
.rr-btn-gold .elementor-button{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F7C66A,#F2A93B);color:#1b1407;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(242,169,59,.7)}
.rr-btn-ghost .elementor-button{background:transparent;color:#fff;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.rr-btn-outline .elementor-button{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:1.5px solid var(--line)}
.rr-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04);transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s,border-color .25s}
.rr-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 24px 48px -24px rgba(15,23,42,.25);border-color:#C9D6FF}
.rr-iconbox .elementor-icon{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(47,91,255,.12),rgba(56,189,248,.12));color:var(--blue);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;font-size:26px}
.rr-iconbox .elementor-icon-box-title{font:700 20px/1.3 Poppins,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:8px}
.rr-iconbox .elementor-icon-box-description{color:var(--slate);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.65}
.rr-counter .elementor-counter-number-wrapper{font:800 46px/1 Poppins,sans-serif;color:#fff}
.rr-counter .elementor-counter-title{color:#9CC2FF;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-top:8px}
.rr-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.rr-nav a{color:var(--ink);font:500 15px/1 Inter,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px}
.rr-nav a:hover{background:var(--bg);color:var(--blue)}
.rr-nav a.rr-cta{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:12px 18px;margin-left:6px}.rr-nav a.rr-cta:hover{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.rr-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);backdrop-filter:saturate(1.6) blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(227,232,242,.8)}
.rr-burger{display:none}
@media(max-width:1024px){.rr-nav{display:none;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;background:#fff;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.rr-nav.open{display:flex}.rr-burger{display:inline-flex;background:var(--bg);border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer}}
.rr-trust{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:8px}
.rr-trust span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#E6ECFA;font:600 13.5px/1 Inter,sans-serif;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:999px}
.rr-trust b{color:var(--gold)}
.rr-hero-photo{position:relative;max-width:520px;margin-left:auto}
.rr-hero-photo:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:8% 6% 0 6%;border-radius:32px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2F5BFF 0%,#1a2f7a 55%,#0B1530 100%);box-shadow:0 40px 80px -30px rgba(47,91,255,.6)}
.rr-hero-photo img{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:0 0 32px 32px}
.rr-float{position:absolute;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px -18px rgba(2,6,23,.45);font:600 13px/1.3 Inter,sans-serif;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.rr-float strong{display:block;font:800 20px/1 Poppins,sans-serif}
.rr-float i{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;font-size:18px;background:#EEF3FF}
.rr-f1{left:-6%;top:28%}.rr-f2{right:-4%;top:12%}.rr-f3{left:4%;bottom:8%}
@media(max-width:767px){.rr-f1,.rr-f2,.rr-f3{display:none}}
.rr-logos{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px 34px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#64748B;font:700 18px/1 Poppins,sans-serif}
.rr-logos a{color:#64748B;text-decoration:none;opacity:.85}.rr-logos a:hover{color:var(--blue);opacity:1}
.rr-gigs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.rr-gigs{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}@media(max-width:640px){.rr-gigs{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rr-gig{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;text-decoration:none!important;color:var(--ink)!important;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.rr-gig:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 30px 50px -28px rgba(15,23,42,.35)}
.rr-gig-img{aspect-ratio:16/10;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg)}.rr-gig-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .5s}.rr-gig:hover .rr-gig-img img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.rr-gig-body{padding:16px 18px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;flex:1}
.rr-gig-seller{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:600 13px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--slate)}
.rr-gig-seller img{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.rr-badge{margin-left:auto;font:700 11px/1 Inter,sans-serif;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:#FFF5DE;color:#9A6400}
.rr-badge.up{background:#E8F7EE;color:#0F7B3E}.rr-badge.fv{background:#E6FAF1;color:#108A5C}.rr-badge.nx{background:#EEF3FF;color:#2F5BFF}
.rr-gig-title{font:600 16px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);min-height:44px}
.rr-gig-rate{font:700 14px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}.rr-gig-rate b{color:#F59E0B}.rr-gig-rate span{color:#94A3B8;font-weight:500}
.rr-gig-foot{margin-top:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font:600 12px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:#94A3B8;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
.rr-gig-foot strong{font:800 18px/1 Poppins,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0}
.rr-cases{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px}@media(max-width:1000px){.rr-cases{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}@media(max-width:640px){.rr-cases{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rr-case{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.rr-case:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 30px 50px -28px rgba(15,23,42,.35)}
.rr-case img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10;object-fit:cover;object-position:top}
.rr-case div{padding:18px 20px 22px}.rr-case h3{font:700 18px/1.35 Poppins,sans-serif;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--ink)}
.rr-case p{margin:0;color:var(--slate);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6}
.rr-tag{display:inline-block;font:700 11px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);background:#EEF3FF;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:10px}
.rr-ways{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px}@media(max-width:900px){.rr-ways{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rr-way{border-radius:20px;padding:30px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.rr-way.hl{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#0B1530,#16295E);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(11,21,48,.8)}
.rr-way h3{font:700 22px/1.25 Poppins,sans-serif;margin:12px 0 8px}.rr-way p{color:var(--slate);margin:0 0 18px;line-height:1.6}.rr-way.hl p{color:#C7D2EA}
.rr-way ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 22px;display:grid;gap:9px}.rr-way li:before{content:"✓";color:var(--blue);font-weight:800;margin-right:8px}.rr-way.hl li:before{color:var(--gold)}
.rr-way a.go{display:inline-block;font:600 15px/1 Inter,sans-serif;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:11px;text-decoration:none;background:var(--navy);color:#fff}.rr-way.hl a.go{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F7C66A,#F2A93B);color:#1b1407}
.rr-pill{display:inline-block;font:700 11px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#EEF3FF;color:var(--blue)}.rr-way.hl .rr-pill{background:rgba(242,181,68,.16);color:var(--gold)}
.rr-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;counter-reset:s}@media(max-width:900px){.rr-steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}@media(max-width:560px){.rr-steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rr-step{padding:26px;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.rr-step:before{counter-increment:s;content:"0" counter(s);font:800 34px/1 Poppins,sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2F5BFF,#38BDF8);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.rr-step h3{font:700 18px/1.3 Poppins,sans-serif;margin:14px 0 6px}.rr-step p{margin:0;color:var(--slate);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.rr-quotes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px}@media(max-width:900px){.rr-quotes{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rr-quote{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:28px}
.rr-quote .s{color:#F59E0B;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:16px}.rr-quote blockquote{margin:12px 0 18px;font:500 17px/1.6 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}
.rr-quote cite{font-style:normal;color:var(--slate);font-size:14px}.rr-quote cite b{display:block;color:var(--ink)}
.rr-faq details{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 22px;margin-bottom:12px}
.rr-faq summary{cursor:pointer;font:600 17px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.rr-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.rr-faq summary:after{content:"+";font-size:22px;color:var(--blue)}.rr-faq details[open] summary:after{content:"–"}
.rr-faq details p{margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.7}
.rr-cta-band{border-radius:28px;padding:56px;background:radial-gradient(800px 300px at 90% 0%,#2F5BFF 0%,rgba(47,91,255,0) 60%),linear-gradient(135deg,#0B1530,#14245C);color:#fff;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.rr-cta-band h2{font:800 clamp(26px,3vw,38px)/1.2 Poppins,sans-serif;margin:0 0 8px;color:#fff}.rr-cta-band p{margin:0;color:#C7D2EA;font-size:17px}
.rr-cta-band .b{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.rr-cta-band a{font:600 16px/1 Inter,sans-serif;padding:16px 22px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none}
.rr-cta-band a.g{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F7C66A,#F2A93B);color:#1b1407}.rr-cta-band a.w{border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);color:#fff}
.rr-footer{background:#0A1229;color:#AAB6D3;padding:72px 24px 28px}
.rr-footer a{color:#D7E0F5;text-decoration:none}.rr-footer a:hover{color:#fff}
.rr-fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:36px}@media(max-width:900px){.rr-fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.rr-fgrid h4{color:#fff;font:700 15px/1 Poppins,sans-serif;margin:0 0 16px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.rr-fgrid ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;gap:10px;font-size:14.5px}
.rr-social{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:16px}.rr-social a{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);font:700 12px/1 Inter,sans-serif}
.rr-social a:hover{background:var(--blue)}
.rr-copy{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);margin-top:44px;padding-top:22px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:13.5px}
.rr-pk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}@media(max-width:900px){.rr-pk{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rr-pkg{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.rr-pkg.pop{border:2px solid var(--blue);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(47,91,255,.55);position:relative}
.rr-popular{position:absolute;top:-13px;left:24px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font:700 11px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px}
.rr-pkg h3{margin:0;font:700 14px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate)}
.rr-pkg .p{font:800 40px/1 Poppins,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}.rr-pkg .p small{font:600 14px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--slate);margin-left:6px}
.rr-pkg .d{color:var(--slate);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;min-height:48px}
.rr-pkg .m{display:flex;gap:14px;font:600 13.5px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}
.rr-pkg ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:4px 0 6px;display:grid;gap:9px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink)}.rr-pkg li:before{content:"✓";color:#16A34A;font-weight:800;margin-right:8px}
.rr-pkg .nfp-pay-button-form{display:block!important}.rr-pkg .nfp-pay-button{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2F5BFF,#3B82F6)!important;border-radius:12px!important;padding:15px!important}
.rr-alt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font-size:14px}.rr-alt a{display:block;text-align:center;padding:12px;border-radius:11px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}.rr-alt a:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
.rr-note{font-size:13px;color:#94A3B8;text-align:center}
.rr-prose{max-width:820px}.rr-prose h3{font:700 22px/1.3 Poppins,sans-serif;margin:28px 0 10px;color:var(--ink)}.rr-prose p,.rr-prose li{color:var(--slate);line-height:1.75;font-size:16.5px}
.rr-tl{border-left:2px solid var(--line);padding-left:26px;display:grid;gap:26px}
.rr-tl div{position:relative}.rr-tl div:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-33px;top:4px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #EEF3FF}
.rr-tl b{display:block;font:700 17px/1.3 Poppins,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}.rr-tl span{font:700 12px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--blue);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}.rr-tl p{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.6}
.rr-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}.rr-chips span{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 14px;font:600 14px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}
.rr-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:28px}.rr-tabs a{padding:12px 18px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);font:600 15px/1 Inter,sans-serif;background:#fff}.rr-tabs a:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
.rr-grid3>.elementor-element{width:calc(33.333% - 15px)!important}
@media(max-width:1024px){.rr-grid3>.elementor-element{width:calc(50% - 11px)!important}}@media(max-width:640px){.rr-grid3>.elementor-element{width:100%!important}}
.rr-counter{min-width:200px;text-align:center}
.rr-narrow{max-width:860px!important}
.rr-about-photo img,.rr-gig-cover img{border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(11,21,48,.6)}
.rr-dark .rr-gig-cover img{box-shadow:0 40px 80px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.elementor-widget-html{width:100%}
.e-con.rr-pkg{--padding-top:26px;--padding-right:26px;--padding-bottom:26px;--padding-left:26px}
.rr-header .elementor-widget-image img{display:block}
.rr-tabs+*{margin-top:0}
a.rr-cta[aria-current]{background:var(--blue)}.rr-nav a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--blue)}
.rr-header .elementor-widget-image img{width:230px!important;max-width:none;height:auto}
@media(max-width:767px){.rr-header .elementor-widget-image img{width:180px!important}}
.rr-header .elementor-widget-html{width:auto!important;margin-left:auto}
.rr-hero-photo img{border-radius:32px}
.elementor-widget-counter .elementor-counter-title,.elementor-icon-box-description,.elementor-widget-text-editor,.elementor-icon-list-text,.elementor-button{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif!important}
.elementor-icon-box-title,.elementor-heading-title{font-family:Poppins,Inter,sans-serif}
.rr-gig-img img{object-position:top left}

.rr-h1s .elementor-heading-title{font:800 clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px)/1.12 Poppins,sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:#fff}
.rr-pkg .m{margin:2px 0 4px}.rr-pkg ul{margin-top:6px}
/* v2 */
.rr-narrow{max-width:860px!important;margin-left:auto!important;margin-right:auto!important;width:100%}
.rr-header{position:sticky!important;top:0;z-index:999}
.admin-bar .rr-header{top:32px}@media(max-width:782px){.admin-bar .rr-header{top:46px}}@media(max-width:600px){.admin-bar .rr-header{top:0}}
.elementor-widget-html:has(>.elementor-widget-container>span[id]:only-child){display:none}
.rr-dd{position:relative}.rr-dd-t em{font-style:normal;font-size:11px;margin-left:2px;opacity:.6}
.rr-dd-m{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,6px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:6px;min-width:620px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:14px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(15,23,42,.3);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.18s;z-index:1000}
.rr-dd-m:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-12px;height:12px}
.rr-dd:hover .rr-dd-m,.rr-dd:focus-within .rr-dd-m{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.rr-dd-c p{margin:4px 10px 8px;font:700 11px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#94A3B8}
.rr-dd-c a{display:flex!important;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px!important;border-radius:12px}
.rr-dd-c a i{width:34px;height:34px;flex:none;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#EEF3FF;color:var(--blue);font-size:14px}
.rr-dd-c a b{display:block;font:600 14.5px/1.3 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}.rr-dd-c a small{display:block;font:400 12.5px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--slate);margin-top:2px}
.rr-dd-c a.all{font:600 13.5px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--blue)!important;padding:12px 10px!important}
@media(max-width:1024px){.rr-dd-m{position:static;transform:none;opacity:1;visibility:visible;min-width:0;grid-template-columns:1fr;box-shadow:none;border:0;padding:0 0 0 10px}.rr-dd-t em{display:none}}
.rr-case{display:block;text-decoration:none!important;color:inherit!important}
